decision: Does replacing only direct sigmoid Brier optimization with unweighted BCE-with-logits repair the rare-positive saturation and reveal episode-stable primitive-set and exploratory action signal?

evaluation.use: single post-selection evaluation on already observed L2d episodes; may select fresh confirmation but is not independent evidence

gate.current_action_signal: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for object-full minus current-action-ablated object-set Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.loss_only_improves_frozen_l2i: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for logscore object-full minus frozen L2i object-full Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.low_propensity_action_signal: behavior-propensity-below-0.025 rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have object-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable directions
gate.nonbaseline_action_signal: known-nonbaseline rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have object-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable directions
gate.object_set_gain: complete-episode bootstrap upper endpoint for object-full minus same-capacity scalar-only Brier is below zero with at least six of eight favorable episode directions
gate.prefirst_hit_lifecycle: pre-first-HIT rows occur in all eight episodes, meet positive support, have object-full minus action-ablated bootstrap upper endpoint below zero, and at least six favorable directions
gate.primitive_contract: all train and evaluation rows match contract v1 and have zero cap-48 token truncation

hypotheses.H1_rare_positive_gradient: L2i's direct sigmoid Brier derivative 2(p-y)p(1-p) vanished on missed rare positives. Unweighted BCE-with-logits retains derivative p-y, reducing saturation and global underprediction without changing the population probability target.
hypotheses.H2_loss_only_correction: The logscore object-full model improves complete-episode Brier over the frozen L2i object-full model with at least six favorable episode directions.
hypotheses.H3_object_information: After the probability-surface correction, object-full improves Brier over the same-architecture scalar-only comparator under the unchanged object-information gate.
hypotheses.H4_exploration_and_lifecycle: The current-action increment passes overall, low-propensity, known-nonbaseline, and pre-first-HIT support, interval, and episode-direction gates rather than remaining baseline-equal only.
hypotheses.H5_selection_limit: The evaluation episodes are already inspected. Passing every unchanged L2i gate plus the loss-only comparator may select wholly fresh confirmation only; it cannot establish causal action value, promote a policy, or authorize value learning.

non_goals: no data, target, token, normalization, architecture, width, depth, pooling, initialization, minibatch, optimizer, learning-rate, regularization, epoch, batch, thread, seed, comparator, or evaluation-gate change from L2i
no loss sweep, class weighting, focal loss, resampling, calibration fit, temperature scaling, early stopping, checkpoint selection, or validation feedback
no history, recurrent state, attention, exhaustive object tensor, raw engine/source field, future birth, counterfactual successor, critic, actor, RL, IQL, CQL, OPE, active collection, or Wine
no behavior propensity, baseline identity, lifecycle label, absolute frame, stage, boss, spell, run identity, source, or future fact as a model input
no causal action-effect, long-horizon action-value, HIT-reduction, NMNB, independent-confirmation, or online-execution claim
